# Version 4.150.4
> **GPU text correctness** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.4)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.4 fixes glyph-atlas tracking and shared-stencil clear coordinates.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Stencil clears across surface origins** — Tracks shared Ganesh stencil-clear bounds in backend-native coordinates so render targets with different origins do not reuse an uncleared region. ([#5083](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5083))
- **Glyph-atlas generation tracking** — Limits generation updates to the regenerated glyph subrun, avoiding reuse of atlas locations for glyphs that may have been evicted. ([#5113](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5113))
- **Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim compatibility** — The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged. ([#5123](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5123))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.4

The bundled Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 through source-scoped warning suppression. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged; unrelated pre-existing BinSkim warnings remain.
